key_insight: Computing total deformation from particle positions and a fixed reference grid enables perfectly elastic MPM solids to recover from large deformations without numerical fracture while retaining current-grid force evaluation.
engineering_relevance: The approach supports simulation of highly deformable elastic components with contact while remaining compatible with standard grid-based MPM collision handling.
method: Compute deformation directly from particle positions using a fixed reference grid, rather than velocity-gradient updates.
Evaluate elastic forces on the current grid to support grid-based contact handling.
Allow particle-level collision handling and suppress zero-energy modes associated with nonlinear deformation artifacts.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports simulations of complex elastic objects undergoing large deformations and contact, but provides no quantitative accuracy or performance metrics.
watch_item: Robustness and computational cost of zero-energy mode suppression and collision coupling require evaluation beyond the abstract.
paper_title: Total Deformation-based MPM for Perfectly Elastic Solid Simulation with Strong Deformations
